Exercise - Using the pipe operator

```{r}
input_vec <- c(5, -10, 4, -3)

print(input_vec |>
        mean() |>
        abs() |>
        round())
```

Exercise - Making comparison

```{r}
y <- 12
print(y == 7)
print(y > 15)
print(y < 20)
print(y <= 12)
```
